@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+package prompt
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"io"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+// Removing restoration on cancellation leaves the terminal in password mode.
+func TestCanceledPasswordReadRestoresTerminalAndAllowsCleanRead(t *testing.T) {
+	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
+	defer pr.Close()
+	defer pw.Close()
+	terminal := &fakeTerm{reader: pr, started: make(chan struct{})}
+	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
+	cr.term = terminal
+	cr.fd = 0
+	defer cr.Close()
+
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
+	result := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, err := cr.ReadPassword(ctx)
+		result <- err
+	}()
+	<-terminal.started
+	cancel()
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-result, context.Canceled)
+	require.True(t, terminal.restoreCalled)
+
+	go func() { _, _ = pw.Write([]byte("next input")) }()
+	got, err := cr.ReadContext(context.Background())
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.Equal(t, "next input", string(got))
+}
+
+// A deadline must discard password data and report the context error.
+func TestPasswordReadDeadlineRestoresTerminal(t *testing.T) {
+	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
+	defer pr.Close()
+	defer pw.Close()
+	terminal := &fakeTerm{reader: pr, started: make(chan struct{})}
+	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
+	cr.term = terminal
+	cr.fd = 0
+	defer cr.Close()
+
+	deadlineCtx, deadlineCancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 100*time.Millisecond)
+	defer deadlineCancel()
+	result := make(chan readOutcome, 1)
+	go func() {
+		value, err := cr.ReadPassword(deadlineCtx)
+		result <- readOutcome{value, err}
+	}()
+	<-terminal.started
+	got := <-result
+	require.Empty(t, got.value)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, got.err, context.DeadlineExceeded)
+	require.True(t, terminal.restoreCalled)
+}
+
+// Closing during a blocked password read must restore the terminal.
+func TestCloseRestoresPasswordTerminal(t *testing.T) {
+	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
+	defer pr.Close()
+	defer pw.Close()
+	terminal := &fakeTerm{reader: pr, started: make(chan struct{})}
+	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
+	cr.term = terminal
+	cr.fd = 0
+	result := make(chan error, 1)
+	go func() {
+		_, err := cr.ReadPassword(context.Background())
+		result <- err
+	}()
+	<-terminal.started
+	require.NoError(t, cr.Close())
+	require.True(t, terminal.restoreCalled)
+	require.ErrorIs(t, <-result, ErrReaderClosed)
+}
+
+// A restoration failure must be returned while the reader still closes.
+func TestCloseReportsTerminalRestoreError(t *testing.T) {
+	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
+	defer pr.Close()
+	defer pw.Close()
+	terminal := &fakeTerm{reader: pr, started: make(chan struct{}), restoreErr: errors.New("restore failed")}
+	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
+	cr.term = terminal
+	cr.fd = 0
+	go func() { _, _ = cr.ReadPassword(context.Background()) }()
+	<-terminal.started
+	require.ErrorIs(t, cr.Close(), terminal.restoreErr)
+	require.True(t, terminal.restoreCalled)
+	_, err := cr.ReadPassword(context.Background())
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrReaderClosed)
+}
+
+// Process exit must close the singleton so an active password read restores it.
+func TestNotifyExitRestoresStdinTerminal(t *testing.T) {
+	pr, pw := io.Pipe()
+	defer pr.Close()
+	defer pw.Close()
+	terminal := &fakeTerm{reader: pr, started: make(chan struct{})}
+	cr := NewContextReader(pr)
+	cr.term = terminal
+	cr.fd = 0
+	stdinMU.Lock()
+	original := stdin
+	stdin = cr
+	stdinMU.Unlock()
+	defer SetStdin(original)
+	go func() { _, _ = cr.ReadPassword(context.Background()) }()
+	<-terminal.started
+	NotifyExit()
+	require.True(t, terminal.restoreCalled)
+	_, err := cr.ReadContext(context.Background())
+	require.ErrorIs(t, err, ErrReaderClosed)
+}
